biocs.name: Suspicious container runtime connection from within a Kubernetes Pod
biocs.description: Detects a process connecting to a container runtime socket from within a Kubernetes Pod environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter dst_port = 10250
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'kubelet'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains 'pod'

abiocs.name: Suspicious container runtime socket access from Pod

abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data

xql_queries.name: Detect suspicious container runtime socket access
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter dst_port = 10250
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'kubelet'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains 'pod'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, dst_port
